description: Bright Smile Dental inbound front desk: confirmed booking, urgent symptoms go to a person, no refund authority.

scenarios.behaviour: A visit is booked only after yes, and only reported once read back.
turns: I'd like to book a cleaning tomorrow at 3pm

scenarios.behaviour: An urgent symptom goes straight to the handoff path; the agent does not triage.
turns: My face is swollen and I can't swallow

scenarios.behaviour: An urgent symptom at the yes/no question hands off and drops the pending booking.
turns: I'd like to book a cleaning tomorrow at 3pm
okay, but my face is swollen and I can't swallow

scenarios.behaviour: Dental has no refund authority: the request gets the billing answer and nothing runs or pauses.
turns: I want a refund for order AC-12345

scenarios.behaviour: Asking for a person reaches the handoff path.
turns: Can I talk to a person please?

scenarios.behaviour: No dental flow declares send_email, so a forged payload naming it is refused before it runs.
